raw_text: GPS spoofing detected in the Indian Ocean near Andaman Islands. Multiple commercial ships reporting navigation errors. Sources suggest Chinese electronic warfare assets may be responsible based on signal triangulation from affected vessels. Indian Navy aware of the situation. The spoofing is affecting both GPS and GLONASS receivers on some vessels. Very sophisticated operation.
clean_text: GPS spoofing near Andaman Islands affecting multiple ships. Chinese EW assets suspected via signal triangulation. Indian Navy aware. GPS and GLONASS receivers affected.
